prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: sys.stderr cannot be passed directly to subprocess in environments where it lacks a real file descriptor (notably Jupyter/IPython kernels, which replace sys.stderr with a ZMQ-backed stream object). prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #2410 makes a minimal, general fix — widening the errlog type annotation from TextIO to TextIO | int so callers can explicitly pass subprocess.DEVNULL or any integer FD. This handles Jupyter and any other non-file-backed stderr without embedding environment-detection heuristics in the library. PR #2020's _is_jupyter_environment() adds ~25 lines of IPython introspection that would need ongoing maintenance as Jupyter internals change; the DEVNULL approach in #2410 achieves the same result with a one-line type change and lets callers opt in rather than the library silently overriding their errlog.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #2410 makes a minimal, general fix — widening the errlog type annotation from TextIO to TextIO | int so callers can explicitly pass subprocess.DEVNULL or any integer FD. This handles Jupyter and any other non-file-backed stderr without embedding environment-detection heuristics in the library. PR #2020's _is_jupyter_environment() adds ~25 lines of IPython introspection that would need ongoing maintenance as Jupyter internals change; the DEVNULL approach in #2410 achieves the same result with a one-line type change and lets callers opt in rather than the library silently overriding their errlog.
